name: Phoenix Valence
source:
Considered as the prodigy of his generation, Phoenix is the youngest mage ever initiated into the Order. He is also a candidate to become the next Archbishop.

Magic: Necromancy - Unusual Mage
Occupation: Member of Ashai's Order
Species: Human
